title: Then and now
prompt: Describe a real or imaginary person’s past and present. Include a past habit, an interrupted past action, a clothing or material description, and a past ability or duty.
checks: I used used to correctly.
I combined past continuous and past simple.
I included a material or clothing adjective.
I used could or had to with the base verb.

title: Experiences and achievements
prompt: Write about a real or imaginary club or performer. Include experiences, a finished past event, an unfinished situation with for or since, and a question tag.
checks: I used present perfect and past simple appropriately.
I distinguished for from since.
I used a noun/adjective family correctly.
My question tag matches the main clause.

title: Describe and respond
prompt: Invent a school-club scene. Describe two people with relative clauses, make a suggestion with should, express a possibility with might, and include agreement or disagreement.
checks: I used who for a person and a suitable pronoun for a thing.
I used base verbs after should and might.
My reply uses the right auxiliary.
The scene is fictional language practice.

title: Describe a lively scene
prompt: Invent a park, museum or café scene. Describe actions in progress, include a feeling and its cause, and write one offer or polite request.
checks: I used There is/are + -ing.
I used a perception verb with an action.
I distinguished an -ed feeling from an -ing description.
I formed an offer or request correctly.

title: Explain a project
prompt: Invent a school or community project. Describe one action that happens regularly, one completed past action, one change up to now and one future plan using passive forms.
checks: I used present, past, perfect and future passive forms.
I included an agent with by where useful.
I used environmental or materials vocabulary.
The project is clearly imaginary or based on facts I know.

title: A plan and an agreement
prompt: Invent a small disagreement about a group activity. Explain two options, describe an agreement, include a first conditional and a future time clause, and state a purpose.
checks: I used present simple after if and a future time word.
I used will in the result or main clause.
I used a noun such as decision, discussion or agreement.
I expressed purpose with to + base verb.
